defects: Mathematical correctness fails at the claimed Tonnetz. The central C has a visible dotted adjacency to F#; C to F# is 6 semitones (a tritone), not a perfect fifth (7) or a major/minor third (4/3). The lattice also repeats C at the center and lower-right with no octave, periodic-cell, or equivalence indication, so the duplicate cannot be read coherently.

The E(5,13) ring itself has five filled steps at 0, 2, 5, 7, and 10. Its cyclic gaps are 2,3,2,3,3, which is a rotation of the Bjorklund gap sequence 3,2,3,2,3; this one mathematical element is correct.

Generated/frozen/manual is not a complete visible semantic system. Frozen Clip 01 uses diagonal hatching, but Pulse Source is only identified by a dot-cluster icon and no material-kind label, and no manual/authored clip treatment is visible. The cyan selection outline is doing unrelated semantic work.

Non-color-only encoding is incomplete: selection has a cyan outline and linked cyan wire, frozen has hatching, and source-state legend uses glyphs; but derivation current, audio playing, evidence, mapping-stage progression, and the material kind of the active source cannot all be distinguished without reading hue-dependent colored text/lines. Error, cancelled, panic, stale, unresolved, and cache-only are not shown.
No error state, budget meter, predicted load, limit, or recovery action is visible.

Accessibility cues score zero: the image provides no accessibility annotation or semantic counterpart for the ring, Tonnetz, graph/pipeline, timeline, or icon-only controls. The top transport, save, share, menu, mute, and solo icons have no visible labels.

S8 handoff gate failures: interaction behavior is not described; there is no accessibility annotation; no paired responsive mockup or written responsive rule is visible; no token-deviation record is visible. Mathematical content also fails validation because of the Tonnetz adjacency.
strengths: The selected Pulse Source is visibly linked from navigator through canvas/pipeline to the selected timeline region and inspector.
The compact toolbar, mixer, graph drawer, inspector, and timeline read as one credible desktop instrument.

defects: Mathematical correctness fails. The ring says E(5,8), rotation 1. Bjorklund E(5,8) has cyclic onset gaps 2,1,2,1,2; with the displayed rotation +1 its onsets should be steps 1,3,4,6,7 (one-based). The image fills 1,3,4,5,6, yielding gaps 2,1,1,1,3. It is not an even Euclidean distribution despite the adjacent claim that it distributes five triggers evenly across eight steps.

The Tonnetz is labeled as a harmonic lattice but does not label its axes or explain its edge relation. The visible C-to-Ab relationship is a minor third while the composition caption calls the path Cmin7 to Abmaj7 to Ebmaj7; the viewer cannot verify fifth/third adjacency from the unlabeled drawn edges.

The visual state system is strongest for material: Manual is a solid filled clip, Generated live is dotted/particle texture, Frozen snapshot is hatched with snowflake glyph, and Edited derivative uses a page/pencil outline. That distinction does not extend visibly to every semantic-state axis: source changed/missing/detached/unresolved, derivation preview/cache-only/stale/error/cancelled, and audio interruption/panic are absent.
No budget prediction, limit, overload/error state, or recovery control is visible; the evaluation table only says current/deterministic.

defects: Mathematical correctness fails. The control states steps 13, pulses 5, rotation +2, but the ring visibly fills steps 01,03,05,08,11. Its cyclic gaps are 2,2,3,3,3. Bjorklund E(5,13) has gaps 3,2,3,2,3; applying rotation +2 to the normalized one-based onsets 1,4,6,9,11 gives 3,6,8,11,13, not 1,3,5,8,11. Both the gap order and the stated rotation disagree with the drawing.

The Tonnetz drawing supplies only C4, E4, G4, A3, D4, and F#4, without axis labels or a full fifths-and-thirds lattice. Its edge geometry therefore cannot substantiate the Tonnetz claim; the displayed C4-to-E4 and E4-to-G4 path is not a lattice explanation.
Text defect: the inspector title is spelled verbatim "Euclidean Pluse"; elsewhere it is "Euclidean Pulse".

Material treatment uses solid line plus pencil for User-authored, dotted texture plus sparkle for Live generated, and hatching plus snowflake/lock for Frozen snapshot. Edited-derivative is absent from the legend and timeline, so the full materialKind vocabulary is not visibly represented.

Derivation/audio current and evidence/research states use text and some glyphs, but mapping is collapsed to one sentence and no visible treatment covers the other sourceStatus, derivation, audio, mapping-stage, or selection states.

screenNotes: All three visibly satisfy S05's three required states and use a dark, compact studio vocabulary. All three nevertheless fail the S8 handoff gate from pixels alone: no interaction specification, accessibility annotation, responsive pair/rule, or token-deviation record is present. All three also omit visible error/budget handling and do not make every semanticStates axis independently non-color-only. A and C have E(5,13) claims, while B has E(5,8); B and C visibly contradict their stated Euclidean parameters, and A's Tonnetz contains a visible C-to-F# tritone adjacency.
recommendationReason: B is still rejected because its E(5,8) geometry is mathematically wrong and it has no accessibility annotation, but it is the only variant that visibly distinguishes all four material kinds with labels, texture, and glyphs while exposing a usable provenance/evaluation surface. Correct its five-onset ring to rotated E(5,8) steps 1,3,4,6,7 before using it as a basis.
